analysis.title: Etsy Inc. (ETSY) Q3'26 Review: Continued Operating Momentum Across Personalization & Buyer Initiatives Produce Upside Earnings Report
key_insights: GS expects a positive share reaction to the Q3'26 report. Management said personalization scaling contributed ~2pts to annualized YoY GMS growth in Q3 and supported buyer growth and changed buyer behavior.

Active Buyers rose YoY for the first time in two years, helped by stronger new buyer acquisition and reactivation. Gross buyers accelerated +6.2% YoY. Buyer health will stay an area of incremental investment into 2027.
Q3 GMS and revenue came in above Street expectations and prior guidance. Consolidated GMS was $2,647mm vs consensus $2,562mm (+3%), and total revenue was $692mm vs consensus $668mm (+4%).
Adj. EBITDA was $210mm vs consensus $196mm (+7%) and GS $190mm. Adj. EBITDA margin was 30.4% vs consensus 29.4%.
Management framed agentic commerce as an opportunity, not a threat. It pointed to its own gifting assistant and to partnering across AI discovery channels so supply stays visible.
Management stressed human curation as a driver of market share. Recent initiatives add safeguards against excess AI use in the listing process.
The company repurchased $395m of shares in the quarter. It says it has flexibility on both capital returns and growth investments as the Depop divestiture recedes.
Negatives: purchase frequency remains modestly down YoY, Q3 marketing expense deleveraged slightly QoQ, and Q4 GMS guidance implies a deceleration to ~6% at the midpoint vs ~9% in Q3.
GS reiterates Neutral and raises its 12-month price target from $89 to $108. With the stock up 61% YTD, GS sees a more balanced risk/reward skew.

GS raised estimates: Q4'26 GMS $3.49bn (prior $3.35bn), revenue $894mm (prior $856mm), adj. EBITDA $268mm (prior $253mm). 2027 GMS is $11.98bn, revenue $3.04bn (prior $2.97bn) and adj. EBITDA $906mm (prior $894mm).

GS expects the investor debate to center on two points: how durable the personalization and buyer gains stay against tougher 2027 revenue comparisons, and how marketing efficiency compares with the return on absolute marketing dollars.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised the PT from $89 to $108 on updated forecasts after the Q3 beat. With the stock up 61% YTD, it sees a balanced risk/reward from here, with 23.2% upside to the target from $87.66.

earnings_insights: Q3'26 reported (10/28): consolidated GMS $2,647mm vs GS est $2,568mm and consensus $2,562mm.
Q3'26 reported: total revenue $692mm vs GS est $669mm and consensus $668mm. Take rate 26.2% vs consensus 26.1%.
Q3'26 reported: marketplace revenue $468mm vs consensus $454mm. Services revenue $224mm vs GS est $202mm and consensus $214mm.
Q3'26 reported: adj. EBITDA $210mm vs GS est $190mm and consensus $196mm. Adj. EBITDA margin 30.4% vs consensus 29.4%.
Q4'26 GMS guidance implies ~6% growth at the midpoint vs ~9% in Q3. GS estimates Q4 GMS $3,488mm, revenue $894mm and adj. EBITDA $268mm (GS estimates, not consensus).

GS FY2026E: revenue $2,886mm, adj. EBITDA $859mm. GS FY2027E: revenue $3,044mm, adj. EBITDA $906mm. GS FY2026E diluted EPS is $8.64, up from $1.85 before this report. GS FY2027E diluted EPS is $4.26 (prior $3.76). These are GS estimates.
risk_factors: Slowdown or acceleration in discretionary consumer spending.
Engagement of buyers and sellers on the platform, and higher or lower buyer and seller churn.
Purchase frequency remains modestly down YoY.
Q4 GMS growth guided to decelerate to ~6% from ~9% in Q3.

tension_points.bull_case: Personalization contributed ~2pts to annualized YoY GMS growth in Q3. Active Buyers rose YoY for the first time in two years, and GS expects a positive share reaction.
tension_points.bear_case: Q4 GMS guidance implies deceleration to ~6% from ~9%. Purchase frequency is still modestly down YoY, and tougher revenue comparisons arrive through 2027.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Q4 GMS growth decelerating to or below the ~6% guided at the midpoint, or buyer growth reversing as 2027 comparisons toughen.

tension_points.bull_case: Management cites momentum in marketing diversification and in the return profile of deployed marketing spend.
tension_points.bear_case: Q3 marketing expenses deleveraged slightly QoQ despite management's comments on efficiency.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Marketing spend continuing to deleverage while buyer growth slows.
